scope: Correctness, lifetimes, admission bounds; no throughput, latency, or RSS comparison
limitations: SQLite shared library was not rebuilt with sanitizers
Linux AArch64 only; no macOS execution
Bounded payload retention excludes SQLite internals, OS socket buffers and client allocations
SQLite operations remain synchronous; absolute deadlines are enforced between those operations
Native connection path is fixed in C; Pure-authored external effects are not implemented
